items.title: Permanence of local finite presentation and local finite type for the third side of a triangle
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors
items.source_version: Stacks Project git a04446e57ec1 (2026-07-28); file descent.tex; corpus local snapshot 20261012
items.difficulty_reason: In the commutative triangle with f : X -> Y surjective, flat and locally of finite presentation and p : X -> S locally of finite presentation (resp. locally of finite type), the lemma concludes the same finiteness property for q : Y -> S (statement lines 4601-4618). The proof is a genuine reduction: the question is local on S and Y, so both may be taken affine; flat local finite presentation makes f open, so finitely many affine opens X_i of X cover Y, and replacing X by their disjoint union reduces to X affine; in that case the statement is exactly the algebra lemma for flat finitely presented permanence (resp. the algebra lemma for finite type on the source) (proof lines 4620-4632). The level is H3: the reduction runs through openness of f and a finiteness argument on the covering, and both the reduction and the final identification with the algebra statement are displayed.
